title: copaiba trapezifolia
intro: Copaiba trapezifolia, commonly known as Copaiba, is a tropical tree native to South America, particularly in Brazil, Peru, and French Guiana. This plant has been used in traditional medicine for centuries due to its numerous health benefits, including anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of Copaiba include pain relief, wound healing, and antiseptic effects, which can be attributed to its bioactive constituents, including alpha-pinene, beta-pinene, and caryophyllene. The bioactive constituents of Copaiba trapezifolia have been shown to exhibit analgesic, anti-inflammatory, and immunomodulatory activities.
